svg.title: Itata / Bío Bío study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Itata; 2: Bío Bío; 3: Coelemu; 4: Quillón; 5: Chillán; 6: Mulchén; 7: Yumbel; 8: Negrete; 9: San Nicolás; 10: Cabrero; 11: Concepción; 12: Los Angeles

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
